name: matsugit
description: Edit Markdown and Org with matsugit document and slide previews in Codex.

interface.longDescription: A local source, rendered and split workspace with document and slide previews, presentation mode, exports and explicitly confirmed Git/CI publication. Requires Node 22+, Python 3.10+ and Quarto. Previewing never publishes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open my Markdown document in the matsugit workspace with a split slide preview.
